map.输入活动效果指标，综合评估活动成效并生成改进建议: Enter campaign performance metrics to score results and generate improvement suggestions
map.工具基于四维度加权模型评估活动成效：到场率（权重 25%）、预算执行率贴合度（权: The tool evaluates campaigns with a four-dimension weighted model: attendance rate (weight 25%), budget execution fit (weight 20%), satisfaction (weight 30%) and goal attainment rate (weight 25%). The composite score runs 0-100 and falls into four bands: Excellent / Good / Acceptable / Needs Improvement, with suggestions generated automatically for low-scoring dimensions. It runs entirely in the browser and no data is uploaded.
map.线下发布会/展会后，用统一分数量化是否值得再办。: After an offline launch or trade show, quantify with a consistent score whether it is worth repeating.
map.线上直播或社群活动复盘，定位哪个维度拖了后腿。: Review an online livestream or community campaign to find which dimension dragged the result down.
map.渠道地推考核，避免只看人数忽略满意度与达成率。: Assess field marketing channels so that headcount never masks satisfaction and attainment.
map.一场发布会的综合评分: Composite score for one launch event
Target participants 1000 and actual 800 gives an 80% attendance rate; budget 100k against spend 95k gives 95% budget fit; satisfaction 8.5/10 gives 85%; goal attainment 90%. Weighted score = 80%×25% + 95%×20% + 85%×30% + 90%×25% = 87.3, rated "Good".
map.若到场率与达成率都高但满意度仅 6 分，综合分被拉到约 77 分，提示内容或体验: If attendance and attainment are both high but satisfaction is only 6, the composite score drops to about 77, showing that content or experience needs work; next time fix the agenda design before adding budget.
map.四维度权重能改吗？: Can the four dimension weights be changed?
map.默认 25%/20%/30%/25% 是通用模板；若活动以转化为核心，可调高达成: The defaults of 25% / 20% / 30% / 25% are a general template; if conversion is the core goal, raise the attainment weight and recompute, but keep the same basis across a batch of campaigns.
map.得分低就代表活动失败？: Does a low score mean the campaign failed?
map.不一定。需看是单一维度偏低还是全面偏低：单维度问题可针对性改，全面偏低才说明活动: Not necessarily. Check whether one dimension is low or all of them are: a single weak dimension can be fixed specifically, while weakness across the board means the campaign design itself needs a rebuild.
map.活动效果评估应从到场率、预算执行、满意度、目标达成四个维度综合评价: Campaign effectiveness should be judged across four dimensions: attendance, budget execution, satisfaction and goal attainment
map.到场率低于80%需分析原因并优化邀请策略: An attendance rate below 80% calls for root-cause analysis and a better invitation strategy
map.满意度调查应在活动结束后48小时内完成: Complete the satisfaction survey within 48 hours after the event
map.评估报告应包含数据分析和定性反馈两部分: An evaluation report should combine data analysis with qualitative feedback
map.活动效果评估工具，从到场率、预算执行、满意度、目标达成率四个维度综合评分并生成改: Campaign effectiveness tool: scores across attendance rate, budget execution, satisfaction and goal attainment, then generates improvement suggestions.
